priority: Primary gameplay mockups; behind-character third-person camera as requested by user
referenceViews: Front and side sheets are supporting animation study only.

sheets.title: Golf — third-person gameplay
sheets.setting: Original bright stylized golf fairway, green and flag ahead, blue sky. Fixed camera BEHIND golfer, slightly above shoulder height. Golfer in lower-left/center foreground with BACK to viewer; fairway target recedes up the frame. Golf ball and clubhead visible ahead of feet. The target direction is away from camera. First 9 panels driver swing, final 3 putter on green. Keep camera behind the player even as torso rotates. No front-facing camera.

sheets.title: Bowling — third-person gameplay
poses: Ball swings down beside right thigh
sheets.setting: Original clean stylized bowling alley, polished wood lane, gutters, full rack of pins at distant end. Camera fixed BEHIND bowler, slightly above shoulders. Player in lower-left/center foreground, back to viewer, pins at upper center. Right-handed delivery: left foot slides forward, right leg trails crossed behind, right hand releases along right side toward pins. One dark blue ball, travels away from camera down lane after release. Do not rotate into front view.

sheets.title: Tennis — third-person gameplay
sheets.setting: Original sunny stylized tennis court, baseline foreground, net across middle, distant opponent beyond net. Fixed third-person camera BEHIND near player, modestly elevated to reveal court. Player back visible in lower-center foreground, facing net. Right-handed player with teal-rim racket; forehand contact to PLAYER RIGHT (screen right from behind), backhand to PLAYER LEFT (screen left). Yellow ball at racket contact, one ball per panel. Opponent small and distant. No front-facing player camera.

sheets.title: Boxing — third-person gameplay
poses: Right cross with rear hip rotation
Block opponent jab with high guard
sheets.setting: Original bright stylized boxing ring, ropes and simple arena behind the opponent. Fixed third-person slightly elevated OVER-THE-SHOULDER camera BEHIND near player, slightly offset so opponent is visible ahead. Main player has BACK to viewer and RED gloves; opponent faces main player with BLUE gloves, same faceless toy character style, slightly farther away. Left jab uses screen-left glove from rear view; right cross uses screen-right glove. Non-graphic sporting action, no bruises or injuries. Keep main player face hidden, never turn camera to front.
